name: Deutsche Umwelthilfe (DUH) – Diesel Bans
description: Actions brought by the NGO Deutsche Umwelthilfe (DUH) against the Länder of Baden-Württemberg (Stuttgart) and Nordrhein-Westfalen (Düsseldorf) over the continued exceedance of the annual NO2 limit value in numerous German cities. At issue was whether the air quality plans in force complied with Directive 2008/50/EC and the Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz and whether it was lawful to impose traffic bans on diesel vehicles.
outcome: The Bundesverwaltungsgericht held that traffic bans (Fahrverbote) on diesel vehicles are legally permissible, and in many situations mandatory, as a measure to comply “in the shortest possible time” with the EU NO2 limits. The judgment paved the way for low-emission zones (Umweltzonen) and numerous diesel bans in more than 60 German cities, including Stuttgart, Hamburg, Berlin and Frankfurt.
